Accurate and easy to use. I’m a fan of this app! Recently removed my copper IUD and wanted to get more in tune with my body. I do have a fairly regular period, and this app very accurately predicts when I’ll start my bleed. I like all the symptoms and extras you can track and notate. I have their paired Bluetooth thermometer and it’s accurate. Mine has no problems connecting or recording when I measure my BBT every morning. Well worth the $ for the year plan. 

A couple things I’d like to see added that would improve my experience: 
1) I wish I could select different types of bleeding throughout the day. Like, especially at the beginning and end of my period. I may start most of the day with light spotting, and then late in the evening my bleed will really increase in flow and change color. So I often don’t know what to mark to describe my period for that day. So it’d be really helpful to have an option to select general timing (morning, afternoon, evening, night) and describe the flow then. 
2) Another option of how painful period cramps are. Slight > Intense is a HUGE jump. If something like “mild” or “medium” could be added, it would help reflect my experience MUCH more accurately.
